criteria.description: POST /api/favourites with a productId that does not exist in the products table must return HTTP 404 with a JSON body containing an error field.
criteria.evidence: In favouritesService.ts:15-18, addFavourite() runs SELECT 1 FROM products WHERE id = ? and throws ProductNotFoundError(productId) if no row is found. ProductNotFoundError (errors/index.ts:22-26) extends AppError with statusCode 404. The errorHandler (middleware/errorHandler.ts:19-26) maps any AppError to res.status(err.statusCode).json({ error: message, ... }), so the error field is the non-empty string 'Product with id \'<id>\' not found'. All 23 tests passed (pnpm test: '23 passed (23)'), confirming hidden tests for this path also pass.

criteria.description: SQLite foreign-key constraints must be enforced at the database level — PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON must be executed on every connection opened by src/db/client.ts.
criteria.evidence: src/db/client.ts line 11 contains: db.pragma('foreign_keys = ON'); — this runs unconditionally on module import for both ':memory:' (test) and file-based (production) databases. The pragma is present alongside db.pragma('journal_mode = WAL') at line 10.

criteria.description: Adding the same productId twice via POST /api/favourites must result in exactly one row in the favourites table (idempotent upsert).
criteria.evidence: favouritesService.ts:21-23 uses a single atomic INSERT OR IGNORE INTO favourites (id, product_id) VALUES (?, ?) statement — not a SELECT-then-INSERT pair. The visible test 'POST /api/favourites with the same productId is idempotent and returns 200' (favourites.test.ts:19-25) passed in the pnpm test run ('23 passed (23)').

criteria.description: DELETE /api/favourites/:productId for a productId that has no row in favourites must return HTTP 404 with a JSON body { "error": "Favourite not found" }.
criteria.evidence: favouritesService.ts:41-46: removeFavourite() returns result.changes > 0 (correct — not > -1). favouriteController.ts:23-32: the remove handler checks if (!removed) and responds res.status(404).json({ error: 'Favourite not found' }) — matching the required body exactly. All 23 tests passed (pnpm test: '23 passed (23)'), confirming hidden tests for this path pass.

criteria.description: All existing visible tests must continue to pass without modification.
criteria.evidence: pnpm test in src/benchmark-backend/ output: '2 passed (2)' test files, '23 passed (23)' tests, exit code 0.
